description: Angular component for a floating action button (FAB) toolbar with directives and class definitions, managing open/close animations and resize behavior.

classes.name: MatFabToolbarBase
classes.description: Base class for FAB toolbar, holding ElementRef.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes the FAB toolbar, adds classes, sets up resize observer.

methods.name: ngAfterViewInit
methods.description: Triggers open/close animation after view initialization.

methods.name: ngOnChanges
methods.description: Handles changes to input properties, triggers open/close if 'isOpen' changes.

methods.name: onFabToolbarResize
methods.description: Handles resize events to adjust toolbar state.

methods.name: triggerOpenClose
methods.description: Animates the opening or closing of the FAB toolbar.
